description: This file defines the ShapeMap class within the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for building and resolving shape references based on definitions provided, primarily used in the context of AWS API shape modeling.

classes.name: ShapeMap
classes.description: Provides functionality to manage and resolve AWS API shape definitions based on shape references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ShapeMap with an array of shape definitions.

methods.name: getShapeNames
methods.description: Returns an array of all shape names defined in the shape map.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a shape reference array into a Shape object, handling simple and complex shapes.
